question: Estimate the B2B opportunity for e-commerce enabler tools (Shopify, GoKwik, Razorpay, etc.) for Indian D2C brands.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total tech stack for Indian D2C: storefront + payments + logistics integration + customer engagement + analytics? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Payment gateway fees (Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe PG): ~₹2-3L (% of GMV).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Payment gateway fees (Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe PG)
- Customer engagement / WhatsApp commerce (Wati, Interakt, AiSensy)

calculationFlow: Of these, on full digital stack (Shopify + payment gateway + customer engagement + ad spend tools): ~70% = 17,500.
- Payment gateway fees (Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe PG): ~₹2-3L (% of GMV).
- Customer engagement / WhatsApp commerce (Wati, Interakt, AiSensy): ~₹50K.
Plus enterprise D2C (large fashion + beauty): adds ~₹400 Cr.
